item.title: Ukraine war latest: Russia attacks passenger bus in Kherson Oblast, killing 1, injuring 5
item.description: Live coverage of Russia’s war against Ukraine with breaking news and frontline updates, updated 8 times today. Russia attacked a passenger bus in Kherson Oblast, killing the driver, and injuring 5 civilians, Kherson Oblast Prosecutor's Office reported on Jan. 30.

item.title: Confusion reigns as Russia says it was only asked to stop attacking Kyiv until Sunday
item.description: The comment from Kremlin spokesperson Dmitri Peskov came a day after Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin had agreed to his request not to strike Kyiv as well as other Ukrainian cities and towns for a week.

item.title: EU considers full ban on Russian oil services to replace price cap, source says
item.description: If approved, the measure would prevent European companies from providing key services for transporting Russian oil.

item.title: US Senate committee backs sanctions bill cracking down on Russia's shadow fleet
item.description: The Shadow Fleet Sanctions Act, introduced by Senators Jim Risch and Jeanne Shaheen in September 2025, expands Washington's authority to penalize shadow fleet vessels and slaps new penalties on Russian liquefied natural gas (LNG) and other energy sector projects.

item.title: Zelensky rejects Putin's Moscow invitation, signals possible delay in peace talks
item.description: "I can just as well invite him to Kyiv, let him come. I'm openly inviting him, if he dares," Zelensky said during a briefing with journalists.

item.title: Putin's envoy to meet with Trump team in Florida ahead of Abu Dhabi peace talks, White House confirms
item.description: Kremlin negotiator Kirill Dmitriev will meet with members of the Trump administration in Florida on Jan. 31, a White House official confirmed to the Kyiv Independent on Jan. 30.

item.title: Iran's top security official meets with Putin amid threats of US military action
item.description: Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary traveled to Russia on Jan. 30 for a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin amid heightened tensions between Tehran and Washington.
